##### Project general facts

Najd Two by Reportage is a modern residential development located in Al Ramal, Riyadh, featuring an exclusive collection of contemporary townhouses designed for comfortable family living. The project comprises just 28 units, offering three- and four-bedroom layouts arranged across multiple levels, including rooftop spaces. The architecture reflects a blend of contemporary Italian design and elegant simplicity, creating a refined residential environment with a focus on space, quality, and functionality.

Residents benefit from a well-planned community environment with a range of amenities, including green areas, a sports club, cafes and restaurants, retail outlets, and recreational facilities such as cinemas. The development also includes a mosque and nearby lifestyle destinations, ensuring a balanced and convenient living experience for families.

Each townhouse is designed with practical layouts and modern features, including private balconies or terraces, rooftop gardens, spacious living areas, and fully equipped kitchens. Interiors are finished with quality materials, offering central air conditioning, en-suite bathrooms, storage spaces, and dedicated maid’s rooms. The homes are built to high international standards, combining everyday comfort with a contemporary residential style.

##### Location description and benefits 

Al Ramal is a rapidly developing residential district located in the northeastern part of Riyadh, offering a modern suburban lifestyle with a growing infrastructure. Known for its spacious layout and new communities, the area attracts families and investors looking for contemporary living in a quieter setting away from the city center.

The district is characterized by a wide selection of villas, townhouses, and newly built residential compounds, complemented by essential amenities such as schools, mosques, retail outlets, and healthcare facilities. Community parks and open spaces are being integrated into the area, creating a comfortable environment for outdoor activities and everyday living.

Al Ramal benefits from its proximity to major highways, providing convenient access to key destinations across Riyadh, including business hubs, educational institutions, and entertainment areas. With continuous development and increasing demand, the district is becoming one of the promising residential locations for both end-users and long-term investment.
